uniqueness.normalization: Unicode NFKC + casefold + removal of whitespace and Unicode P/S punctuation/symbol categories; semantic paraphrases remain distinct.

provenance.generation_basis: Codex synthetic Japanese commands created from label and slot contract; no model-output-informed selection.

assumptions: explicit_voice_command context is assumed, as specified by the contract. Short requests without a verb remain commands in that mode.
The requested exact anchor 保存して has 4 characters and is the intentional exception to the preferred 5-character minimum.
All examples request one action. Repetition counts, target locators, scene queries and candidate counts are arguments of that action.
Negation corrections, preservation clauses, narrative prefixes and independent compound actions are omitted. Explicit off/disable settings remain valid commands.
Natural conventional phrases are retained without any assertion that they are absent from training. Parent owns train/evaluation overlap analysis.
Slots are gold annotations only, not classifier outputs, execution permission or guaranteed available operations.
The contract lists supported bubble fields but does not prescribe value nesting. This draft uses slots.value for literal or boolean values, and {width:30,unit:mm} for BBox width.
The contract does not specify the spread/guide boolean slot name. This draft uses slots.enabled as the desired final display state, consistent with the explicit boolean settings convention.
The spoken shape 楕円 is retained as a literal rather than inventing an implementation enum ID. The implementation must resolve it later.
ノーマル素材 is interpreted as the spelling nomal explicitly mentioned by the contract; the spoken alias and material ID require parent confirmation.
ネーム is interpreted as storyboard; キャラクター is interpreted as characters. Actual UI tab captions were not inspected.
Unqualified history commands default to one operation. Explicit 2回/3回 undo and redo counts are one action with a count.
直前の描画を取り消して and 取り消した描画をやり直して assume the applicable history item is a drawing edit; they do not authorize searching past unrelated entries.
The sample name 葵ちゃん is synthetic. Honorifics are retained and runtime existence/uniqueness must be resolved.
User-facing page and panel numbers are positive and 1-based; actual range and panel IDs must be checked by the execution layer.
The bare term 背景候補 uses the contract-confirmed abbreviation for registered 3D model candidates. Scene query values do not assert registered model availability.
今のページの3D背景候補 refers to current-page context; the contract has no page context slot, so this detail is retained in text/note instead of inventing a locator.
Text-frame alignment always names an explicit selection of multiple text frames. Counts of 2 or 3 remain in text/note because the contract has no selection-count slot.
Save, binary toggles, artwork mode and paint mode have inherently narrow subaction sets; their 8 examples use common wording in addition to state/mode coverage.
View-change allocation is 2 zoom, 2 spread, 2 guide, 2 tab examples. It does not exhaust every listed zoom, guide or tab value.

Bubble-set allocation covers shape, preset, tail_enabled both states, clip_to_panel, bbox width, text and speaker; owner/join_to are omitted to avoid unsupported interpretations of underspecified values.

ambiguous_items_requiring_review.issue: Short undo phrasings refer to edit history; confirm ordinary one-step or counted interpretation.
取り消した操作を戻して is annotated redo because the operation was explicitly undone.
Japanese names of storyboard/characters tabs are semantic aliases; UI labels not verified.
楕円 is a literal requested shape; implementation shape identifier is not specified in the contract.
ノーマル素材 to nomal is an explicit draft alias assumption.
切取り設定をclip_to_panelに対応づける。契約上UI検証待ちのため実行可能とはみなさない。
Current-page scene context is represented in text/note, with no invented page locator.
Explicit selected frame counts are recorded only in text/note; no count slot exists for this label.

capability_caveats: The label contract is itself pending_user_review. This draft does not establish voice wiring, runtime readiness or executable capability.
clip_to_panel remains under work and must not be executed before UI verification completes.
Owner generation has an existing UI workflow but is not voice wired. Opening the generation dialog is not job completion or result insertion.
Whole-page generation is pending normal UI integration; whole-panel generation is inactive legacy UI. Neither is replaced by background-only generation or a saved-file CLI.
Registered 3D catalog availability does not imply candidate selection/display is implemented. Suggestions must use real registered models and must not be auto-applied.
text_frames_align requires independent editable text frames and multi-selection improvements. This dataset does not claim those requirements are implemented.
Actual selection, target identity, model names, registered materials, valid ranges, current unsaved UI state and availability remain execution-layer responsibilities.
validation_performed: Exactly 112 rows; precisely 8 for each of 14 included action/workflow labels.

All text lengths <=40 Unicode code points; preferred 5-25 range checked and exceptions enumerated.
Both exact requested anchors are present.
Manual composition against the label contract; no model inference and no training/test overlap inspection.

Checked all provided labels, enum values, positive numeric arguments, booleans and shared locators. Bubble value/view enabled keys use the explicitly documented draft annotation convention because the source contract does not prescribe those keys.

decisions: 全112文の入力・ラベル・引数注釈を読んで確認。各文は既存定義上の単一操作。回数や複数対象は一つの操作の引数でありcompoundにしない。
Undo/Redoの履歴参照は明示され、daily_019は取り消された操作の復元なのでredo。
ネーム→storyboard、キャラクター→charactersは注釈上の意味対応として保持。表示切替という分類を評価し、実UI配線は検証しない。
楕円は原文のリテラル。ノーマル→nomalは契約に記載の素材綴りを保持する注釈であり、素材選択の実行精度を主張しない。
切取りは契約のbubble_set定義に含まれる。clip_to_panel等の実装準備状況を変更せず、分類だけを評価。
人物名・ページやコマ番号・現在ページ・選択中の対象は実行側が解決する前提。新しい対象を生成したり指定範囲を広げたりしない。
bubbleのvalueとviewのenabledは正解注釈のローカル表記。スロットの予測や契約の実行用スキーマ追加は行わない。
112文すべてを固定し、推論後の言い換え・削除・ラベル訂正で点数を上げない。
